# TechNext — full reference

Last updated: 2026-11-08

> TechNext Pte. Ltd. (UEN 202699888G) is an Odoo Ready Partner headquartered in Singapore, with its main development and consulting hub in Taguig City, Metro Manila. It is an affordable Odoo ERP partner for SMEs: it plugs Odoo into the system a business already runs (accounting software, ERP, POS or in-house), starting with accounting, gives a fixed written quote first, sets it up for BIR requirements (Odoo set up for the client's own BIR Computerized Accounting System (CAS) or CBA application, with sample printouts, 2307, SLSP, SAWT and QAP; e-invoicing planned separately) and for Singapore GST and InvoiceNow (with the client's chosen Access Point), and implements the full Odoo ERP when a business is ready. No accounting software is BIR-accredited, and the BIR has accredited no e-invoicing service provider (BIR advisory, 14 Sep 2026). It is not affiliated with, accredited by or acting for the BIR or any government agency, and it does not file or register on a client's behalf. 142 ERP projects; 90+ enterprise clients in 25+ countries.

## Questions and answers

### Do we need a CAS or a CBA?

RMO 9-2021 draws the line at invoices. If your system issues them, it is a CAS; if invoices are issued by hand and the system keeps your books, it is a CBA. Large taxpayers must use a CAS. We go through it with your accountant on the first call, and your RDO can confirm it.

Source: https://technext.asia/bir-adviser-call

### Is TechNext BIR-accredited?

No, and no accounting software is: the BIR registers each business's use of a system, not a software brand, and it has warned against "BIR-accredited" claims. What we do is set up your Odoo for the BIR's requirements and prepare with you the sample outputs and audit trail printout for the CAS or CBA application you file.

Source: https://technext.asia/bir-adviser-call

### Can Odoo produce our 2307s, SLSP, SAWT and QAP?

Yes. Odoo's Philippine localisation generates 2306 and 2307 certificates from vendor bills, and SLSP, SAWT and QAP with DAT exports, from the same entries as your books.

Source: https://technext.asia/bir-adviser-call

### We already have a CAS permit for our current system. What happens?

A new accounting system usually needs its own BIR registration. Check the details with your accountant; we prepare the process flow and sample outputs straight from your Odoo, so the application reflects the system you will actually use.

Source: https://technext.asia/bir-adviser-call

### Who do you work with?

Companies in the Philippines, Singapore and Vietnam that run their Odoo with TechNext. In Singapore we set up GST instead, and work with the InvoiceNow Access Point you choose. We confirm the details on the first call.

Source: https://technext.asia/bir-adviser-call

### What is a BIR Computerized Accounting System (CAS)?

A CAS is a computerised system that records a business's transactions, generates its invoices and produces its books of accounts and financial reports. Under RMO 9-2021 a business registers its CAS with the BIR at its Revenue District Office (RDO) or Large Taxpayers office. If the system issues invoices by hand, it counts as Computerized Books of Accounts (CBA) instead.

Source: https://technext.asia/bir-cas

### Is there BIR-accredited accounting software?

No. The BIR registers each taxpayer's use of a system, not a software brand. In its public advisory of 14 September 2026 it said it has not accredited any e-invoicing service provider and warned against "BIR-accredited" claims. Your business registers Odoo as its CAS or CBA and, if the RDO accepts the application, receives an Acknowledgement Certificate. See BIR rules for your accounting system .

Source: https://technext.asia/bir-cas

### Do I still need a Permit to Use (PTU)?

No. RMC 5-2021 replaced the Permit to Use with registration and an Acknowledgement Certificate (AC). Existing PTUs stay valid unless revoked or the system has a major enhancement.

Source: https://technext.asia/bir-cas

### How long does CAS registration take?

Under RMC 5-2021, the RDO issues the Acknowledgement Certificate within three working days of a complete application; the timing and the decision are the RDO's. There is no demonstration before you start: the RDO evaluates the system afterwards and can revoke the certificate if it finds gaps, which is why we review the requirements with you before you file.

Source: https://technext.asia/bir-cas

### Can Odoo Online or Odoo.sh be registered as a CAS?

Yes. RMO 9-2021 covers cloud and third-party systems. You and the provider sign a joint sworn statement that the system cannot suppress sales, and the registration is cancelled if the provider contract ends.

Source: https://technext.asia/bir-cas

### Does my Acknowledgement Certificate let me issue e-invoices?

No. Under RMC 98-2026 the AC authorises the system but not e-invoicing. Covered taxpayers also need a Permit to Issue (PTI), then EIS Certification within six months, and the covered groups must issue e-invoices by 31 December 2026.

Source: https://technext.asia/bir-cas

### Do I need to re-register after upgrading Odoo?

A version change that affects the financial side counts as a major enhancement, which needs an updated registration before you use it. Minor changes, such as screen changes or bug fixes, need only a written notice. We plan the upgrade so you can file the updated registration first.

Source: https://technext.asia/bir-cas

### Does TechNext file the CAS application for us?

Your business files at its RDO or Large Taxpayers office, in person or by email. We set up the system, prepare the sample printouts, the audit trail and the system description with you, and stay on call for the RDO's questions. The registration decision is the BIR's.

Source: https://technext.asia/bir-cas

### What is the BIR e-invoicing deadline?

Covered taxpayers must issue electronic invoices on or before 31 December 2026. RR 26-2025 set the date and RMC 98-2026 kept it.

Source: https://technext.asia/bir-e-invoicing

### Are micro taxpayers covered by BIR e-invoicing?

No. Micro taxpayers are exempt from mandatory BIR e-invoicing, and e-commerce coverage applies to sellers classed as small, medium or large.

Source: https://technext.asia/bir-e-invoicing

### What is a Permit to Issue (PTI)?

A Permit to Issue (PTI) Electronic Invoice is the BIR permit a covered taxpayer needs before issuing any e-invoice. EIS Certification must then be completed within six months of the PTI.

Source: https://technext.asia/bir-e-invoicing

### Is Odoo BIR compliant?

No accounting software is certified as BIR compliant: the BIR does not accredit accounting software brands, it has not accredited or endorsed any e-invoicing service provider (BIR advisory, 14 September 2026), and the permit is issued to your business for the system you register. Odoo 20's Philippine localisation covers invoices set up for BIR and CAS requirements, a Book of Accounts, 2306 and 2307 certificates, SLSP, SAWT, QAP and 2550Q. Its release notes do not cover an EIS connection, and TechNext has not built one; we assess what one needs and plan it as separate work. You file your CAS and e-invoicing applications with the BIR yourself. See BIR rules for your accounting system .

Source: https://technext.asia/bir-e-invoicing

### Can we fix an e-invoice after it is issued?

No. Issued e-invoices cannot be deleted or changed. Use a credit note for a decrease and a new e-invoice for an increase; we set both flows up in Odoo before go-live.

Source: https://technext.asia/bir-e-invoicing

### Does BIR e-invoicing cover our branches?

Yes. BIR e-invoicing covers head office and all branches, and branches on different invoicing systems may need separate PTIs. See BIR rules for multi-branch businesses .

Source: https://technext.asia/bir-e-invoicing

### Is any accounting software BIR-accredited?

No. In its 14 September 2026 advisory, the BIR said it has not accredited, certified or endorsed any e-invoicing service provider, and warned against such claims. The BIR registers each business's own CAS or CBA instead.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-accounting-software-philippines-odoo

### Odoo or QuickBooks for a Philippine small business?

It depends on what you need beyond accounting and how you will produce your BIR lists. Odoo's Philippine localisation documents the 2307, SLSP, SAWT and QAP outputs. For QuickBooks Online, ask the vendor or a local add-on provider how it produces them.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-accounting-software-philippines-odoo

### Can I keep using Excel for invoices?

If you are covered by e-invoicing, no. RMC 98-2026 says invoices made in Word, Excel, Google Docs or Google Sheets are not valid electronic invoices. Covered taxpayers must issue e-invoices on or before 31 December 2026.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-accounting-software-philippines-odoo

### Does Odoo connect to the BIR's EIS?

Not out of the box. Odoo has no built-in EIS connection, and TechNext has not built one. If your business needs it, we assess the work and quote it separately.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-accounting-software-philippines-odoo

### Do I need to re-register if I switch software?

Usually, yes. A new system is a new CAS or CBA application, and RMC 98-2026 requires a new or amended Permit to Issue when you migrate e-invoicing systems. Check the steps with your RDO.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-accounting-software-philippines-odoo

### Does my ATP or my printed invoice expire?

No. RR 6-2022 removed the five-year validity from 16 July 2022. ATP invoices can be used until the series runs out, and an old "valid until" date on unused booklets is disregarded, unless it had already passed on or before 15 July 2022.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-atp-authority-to-print-vs-system-invoices

### Do I need an ATP for invoices from Odoo or another system?

RR 7-2024 links the ATP to manual invoices printed by an accredited printer. Invoices generated by a registered CAS come under its Acknowledgement Certificate, and a POS machine's invoices under its Permit to Use. Any invoices printed in booklets, including back-up sets, need an ATP. Covered e-invoicing taxpayers also need a Permit to Issue (RMC 98-2026).

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-atp-authority-to-print-vs-system-invoices

### How many back-up invoices can I keep for system downtime?

Under RMO 9-2021, pre-printed back-up invoices with an approved ATP, set aside for downtime of a system without redundancy, should not exceed 1,000 sets at a time.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-atp-authority-to-print-vs-system-invoices

### Where do I apply for an ATP?

Online in ORUS, available nationwide since 16 January 2023, or at the RDO with jurisdiction over your head office using BIR Form 1906 (October 2025 version, per RMC 97-2025). Branches can apply through their own ORUS branch account.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-atp-authority-to-print-vs-system-invoices

### How long must I keep my books for the BIR?

Five years from the day after the deadline for filing the return, under Section 235 of the Tax Code as amended by the EOPT Act. Computerised books are kept as electronic copies.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-audit-readiness-odoo

### How many days do I have to submit documents in a BIR audit?

You have ten calendar days from the BIR's request to submit the documents, under RMO 22-2026.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-audit-readiness-odoo

### Can someone delete a posted invoice in Odoo?

With the Restrictive Audit Trail setting on, tracked accounting records can only be cancelled or archived, and every change is logged with the user and time.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-audit-readiness-odoo

### Can the BIR audit me more than once for the same year?

Under RMO 1-2026 the BIR generally issues one eLA per taxable year covering all taxes, with exceptions such as fraud, tax clearance and one-time transactions.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-audit-readiness-odoo

### What is the difference between manual, loose-leaf and computerized books?

Manual books are written by hand in bound books. Loose-leaf books are printed during the year and permanently bound after it closes. Computerized books are kept in a registered system, either a CBA (books only) or a CAS (the full cycle, including invoices).

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-books-of-accounts-manual-loose-leaf-computerized-odoo

### When must loose-leaf books be bound and registered?

Within 15 days after the end of each taxable year, through ORUS. For taxable year 2025 the BIR extended this to 31 January 2026 under RMC 4-2026, so do not plan around an extension.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-books-of-accounts-manual-loose-leaf-computerized-odoo

### When are computerized books registered?

Within 30 days after the end of each taxable year, through ORUS. For taxable year 2025 the deadline was extended to 17 February 2026. Ask your RDO whether it also wants the USB drive and transmittal letter.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-books-of-accounts-manual-loose-leaf-computerized-odoo

### How long do I keep my books of accounts?

Five years from the day after the filing deadline, under Section 235 of the Tax Code as amended by the EOPT Act. Paper books are kept as hard copies and computerized books as electronic copies (RR 7-2024).

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-books-of-accounts-manual-loose-leaf-computerized-odoo

### Is Odoo registered with the BIR as computerized books?

The BIR registers each taxpayer's own system, not a software brand. Your business registers Odoo as its CAS or CBA at your RDO and registers its books through ORUS. Odoo 20 adds a Book of Accounts for Philippine CAS and CBA users, which we prepare with you.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-books-of-accounts-manual-loose-leaf-computerized-odoo

### Loose-leaf vs bound books: what is the difference?

Bound (manual) books are written by hand and registered before you use them. Loose-leaf books are printed during the year, then permanently bound and registered through ORUS within 15 days after the taxable year ends. Both are kept as hard copies (RR 7-2024).

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-books-of-accounts-manual-loose-leaf-computerized-odoo

### What is the BIR e-invoicing deadline?

Covered taxpayers must issue electronic invoices that meet BIR requirements on or before 31 December 2026. RR 26-2025 set the date and RMC 98-2026 kept it.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-e-invoicing-odoo

### Are micro taxpayers covered?

No. The BIR's guidelines exempt micro taxpayers from the mandatory e-invoicing requirement.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-e-invoicing-odoo

### Is my CAS registration enough to issue e-invoices?

No. Under RMC 98-2026 the registration of your CAS authorises the system, not e-invoicing: you also need a Permit to Issue (PTI) Electronic Invoice before you issue any e-invoice, and EIS Certification within six months of the PTI. See BIR CAS set-up .

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-e-invoicing-odoo

### Does Odoo handle BIR e-invoicing out of the box?

Odoo's Philippine localisation covers taxes, withholding and BIR reports such as 2550Q, SLSP, SAWT, QAP and a 2307 export. Its documentation does not mention EIS. Odoo has no built-in connection to the BIR's EIS, and TechNext has not built one. If you are covered, we assess the options with you and quote any connection separately.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-e-invoicing-odoo

### Can TechNext help us prepare?

Yes, on the Odoo side. Our team in Taguig City goes through your group with you and your accountant, sets up Odoo's invoicing for BIR requirements, assesses any EIS connection separately, and stays on after go-live. You file your PTI and other applications yourself, and we cannot promise BIR approval or a date.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-e-invoicing-odoo

### When must I issue Form 2307 to my suppliers?

Issue Form 2307 to your suppliers within 20 days after the close of each quarter, or at the time of payment if the supplier asks, under RR 2-98 as amended by RR 11-2018.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-form-2307-odoo

### What is the difference between Form 2306 and 2307?

Form 2307 certifies creditable withholding tax, which the payee claims as a credit. Form 2306 certifies final withholding tax.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-form-2307-odoo

### Can Odoo print the BIR 2307 as a PDF?

In Odoo 20, yes: the 2306 & 2307 report generates the certificates in the BIR PDF format. Odoo 18 and 19 export the data as XLS for conversion.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-form-2307-odoo

### Can I claim a government VAT 2307 against income tax?

No. Under RMC 36-2021, VAT withheld by government is credited against your VAT. Using it against income tax leads to disallowance.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-form-2307-odoo

### What is the difference between Form 2307 and Form 2316?

Form 2307 is given by a payor to a supplier or other payee for creditable tax withheld on income payments, within 20 days after each quarter. Form 2316 is the Certificate of Compensation Payment and Tax Withheld that an employer gives each employee, on or before 31 January of the following year, or on the last pay day if employment ends earlier (RR 11-2018).

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-form-2307-odoo

### How is the amount on a 2307 computed?

Each income payment is multiplied by the rate for its ATC, and the 2307 shows the monthly amounts, the quarterly total and the tax withheld. For example, a P100,000 payment to a contractor at 2% means P2,000 withheld. Your accountant confirms which ATC and rate apply.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-form-2307-odoo

### When is the 2550Q due?

Within 25 days after the close of each taxable quarter, under Section 114(A) of the Tax Code as amended by the TRAIN Law. It is filed every quarter while you are VAT-registered, even with no sales.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-form-2550q-quarterly-vat-odoo

### Do I still need to file the monthly 2550M?

No. It has not been mandatory since 1 January 2023. RMC 52-2023 lets you keep filing it for the first two months of a quarter if you choose to.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-form-2550q-quarterly-vat-odoo

### Does Odoo file the 2550Q with the BIR?

Odoo prepares the figures in its 2550Q report from your posted entries. You file the return on the BIR's platform, using those figures.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-form-2550q-quarterly-vat-odoo

### When do I declare VAT on a service I invoiced but have not been paid for?

Declare it in the quarter of the invoice, even if you have not been paid. Since RR 3-2024 under the EOPT Act, VAT on services is recognised when you invoice, the same as for goods.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-form-2550q-quarterly-vat-odoo

### When is the 2551Q due?

Within 25 days after the end of each taxable quarter. For a calendar-year business, that is late April, July, October and January.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-form-2551q-percentage-tax-odoo

### Is percentage tax still 1%?

No. The 1% rate under the CREATE Act ran from 1 July 2020 to 30 June 2023. The Section 116 rate is back to 3% of gross quarterly sales.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-form-2551q-percentage-tax-odoo

### I chose the 8% income tax. Do I still file the 2551Q?

Under Section 24(A)(2)(b), the 8% is paid in place of the graduated income tax and the Section 116 percentage tax. Ask your accountant to confirm what your registration requires, especially if your sales may pass P3,000,000 during the year.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-form-2551q-percentage-tax-odoo

### What happens when my sales pass P3,000,000?

Section 236(G) requires you to register for VAT. You then file the 2550Q instead of the 2551Q. Plan the switch with your accountant and RDO.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-form-2551q-percentage-tax-odoo

### Does Odoo file the 2551Q with the BIR?

No. Odoo prepares the figures from your posted invoices, through the 2551Q report in Odoo 20 or a tax report in earlier versions. You file the return on the BIR's platform yourself.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-form-2551q-percentage-tax-odoo

### Does each branch file its own VAT return?

No. VAT is filed in one consolidated return for the head office and all branches, under Section 114(A) of the Tax Code.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-multi-branch-odoo

### Does each branch need its own PTI for e-invoicing?

Branches on the same invoicing system share the head office's PTI number. A branch on a different system needs a separate PTI, under RMC 98-2026.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-multi-branch-odoo

### Can Odoo keep a separate invoice series per branch?

Yes. Each branch can have its own sales journal, and each journal numbers its invoices in its own sequence.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-multi-branch-odoo

### Should a branch be a branch or a separate company in Odoo?

A BIR-registered branch that shares your TIN is a branch in Odoo. A separate legal entity with its own TIN is a separate company in the same database.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-multi-branch-odoo

### What is a BIR Permit to Use for a POS?

It is the BIR's permit for one specific CRM or POS machine used by one business. It comes with a Machine Identification Number, and the PTU number and date issued are printed on the machine's invoices.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-pos-accreditation-ptu-requirements

### Is an accredited POS enough?

No. Accreditation covers the software version. Each machine the business uses still needs its own PTU, filed in eAccReg by the supplier on the business's behalf.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-pos-accreditation-ptu-requirements

### Does my PTU expire when the supplier's accreditation expires?

No. RMC 72-2025, citing RR 6-2022, says PTUs do not expire and need not be cancelled when the software's accreditation expires.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-pos-accreditation-ptu-requirements

### Does my CAS registration cover my POS?

No. RMO 24-2023 lists a POS that is a component of a CAS as needing both accreditation and registration. The CAS Acknowledgement Certificate covers the accounting system.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-pos-accreditation-ptu-requirements

### Can Odoo Point of Sale be used for BIR-registered sales?

Odoo POS receipts, invoices and register closing can be configured, but configuration alone does not make a POS usable for registered sales. The version you run still has to be accredited, and each machine needs its own PTU, filed by the accredited supplier. Settle who that is with your accountant, your RDO and your POS supplier before go-live.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-pos-accreditation-ptu-requirements

### Is Odoo BIR-accredited?

No accounting software brand is "BIR-accredited" in the way the question suggests. The BIR registers your books and issues your PTI for the system you use, and as of its 14 September 2026 advisory it had not accredited any e-invoicing service provider. Your business can register Odoo as its computerised books and use it for its PTI application.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-rules-for-your-accounting-system

### What is the difference between an RR, an RMC and an RMO?

A Revenue Regulation (RR) sets binding rules under the Tax Code. A Revenue Memorandum Circular (RMC) explains or clarifies them for taxpayers. A Revenue Memorandum Order (RMO) tells BIR offices how to carry them out.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-rules-for-your-accounting-system

### Do I still need to register my books if I use Odoo?

Yes. Books of accounts are registered through ORUS (RMC 3-2023 and RMC 4-2026), whatever system produces them.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-rules-for-your-accounting-system

### Can Odoo produce my 2307 and SLSP?

Yes. The Philippine localisation produces 2307 data per payee and exports the SLSP, SAWT and QAP as DAT files for the BIR's tools, from the invoices and bills you post.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-rules-for-your-accounting-system

### What is the difference between SAWT and QAP?

The SAWT lists tax that customers withheld from you, built from the 2307s you received. The QAP lists tax you withheld from your suppliers, attached to your 1601-EQ or 1601-FQ.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-sawt-qap-alphalist-odoo

### When is the QAP due?

With the 1601-EQ or 1601-FQ, on the last day of the month after the quarter closes, as RMC 55-2026 restates.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-sawt-qap-alphalist-odoo

### What happens if my alphalist fails validation?

The BIR emails the reasons. Under RMC 5-2014 you resubmit a corrected, complete list within five days. A list that never uploads is treated as not received, which can disallow the related expenses.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-sawt-qap-alphalist-odoo

### Does Odoo create SAWT and QAP files?

Yes. The Philippine localisation exports both as DAT files compatible with the BIR Alphalist module, from the withholding taxes on your invoices and bills.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-sawt-qap-alphalist-odoo

### Who must submit the SLSP?

Persons liable for VAT, under RR 1-2012. The amended rules list manufacturers, wholesalers and service providers among others, and set no turnover threshold.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-slsp-summary-list-sales-purchases-odoo

### When is the SLSP due?

It follows the quarterly VAT return. RMO 4-2003 ties it to the VAT return due date, now the 25th day after the quarter closes. Published 2026 tax calendars give eFPS filers until the 30th day of the month after the quarter to e-submit it.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-slsp-summary-list-sales-purchases-odoo

### Can Odoo export the SLSP for RELIEF?

Yes. The Philippine localisation exports the SLSP as a DAT file compatible with the BIR's RELIEF module, one month at a time.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-slsp-summary-list-sales-purchases-odoo

### What if a customer has no TIN?

Collect the customer's TIN when you can and keep the customer record complete: missing and placeholder TINs are among the most common reasons for SLSP problems. If you cannot get one, ask your accountant or RDO how to report that sale in the SLSP.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-slsp-summary-list-sales-purchases-odoo

### Do eFPS filers have different deadlines?

For the monthly 0619-E, 0619-F and 1601-C, yes. eFPS filers may have staggered dates by industry group, from the 11th to the 15th of the following month. eBIRForms filers use the 10th. Quarterly and annual returns generally share one date.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-tax-calendar-deadlines-odoo

### Do I file a 0619-E for the third month of the quarter?

No. The 0619-E and 0619-F cover the first two months. The third month goes into the 1601-EQ or 1601-FQ, due the last day of the month after the quarter.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-tax-calendar-deadlines-odoo

### When are the 1604-C and 1604-E due?

The 1604-C (and the 1604-F) by 31 January of the following year, and the 1604-E by 1 March, each with its alphalist. RMC 55-2026 restates these dates.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-tax-calendar-deadlines-odoo

### When do I submit the audited financial statements?

For an electronically filed 1702-RT, the AFS and other attachments go through the BIR's eAFS system within 15 days after the filing deadline. For a calendar-year company, that is 30 April.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-tax-calendar-deadlines-odoo

### Does Odoo file these returns with the BIR?

No. Odoo prepares the figures in its reports and DAT exports. You file and pay on eBIRForms or eFPS yourself. Odoo also has no built-in connection to the BIR's EIS, and TechNext has not built one.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-tax-calendar-deadlines-odoo

### What is the difference between RAG and fine-tuning?

Fine-tuning changes the model itself by training it on examples, which suits style and format. RAG leaves the model alone and gives it the right documents at question time, which suits facts that change. For company knowledge, RAG is usually the first choice because updates only need a re-index and answers can cite sources.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/enterprise-rag-guide

### Does RAG stop AI from making things up?

It reduces it a lot but does not remove it. Strict instructions to answer only from sources, required citations, permission to say "I don't know" and regular testing against a fixed question set keep it in check.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/enterprise-rag-guide

### What documents can an enterprise RAG system use?

Most text-based content: PDFs, Word files, spreadsheets, wiki pages, helpdesk articles and email archives. Scanned documents need OCR first, and tables need careful parsing to stay readable.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/enterprise-rag-guide

### Can users see documents they are not allowed to open?

They should not. A well-built system carries each document's access rights into the index and filters results by the signed-in user before anything reaches the model.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/enterprise-rag-guide

### How long does an enterprise RAG implementation take?

It depends mostly on the state of your sources and the number of systems to connect. Starting with one use case and a pilot group gets a working assistant in front of real users sooner, and the rest is added in phases.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/enterprise-rag-guide

### Do service companies still issue official receipts?

The invoice is now the proof of sale for services too. An official receipt may still be issued when payment is collected, but only as a supplementary document.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/eopt-invoice-requirements-odoo

### When must an invoice show the buyer's TIN?

For sales of P1,000 or more to a VAT-registered buyer, the invoice must show the buyer's registered name, address and TIN (Tax Code Section 113(B)).

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/eopt-invoice-requirements-odoo

### What must a system-generated invoice show at the bottom?

The PTU number or Acknowledgement Certificate control number, the series range and the date issued, under RR 7-2024 Section 6(B.21).

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/eopt-invoice-requirements-odoo

### Can I still use my old official receipts?

Yes, under RR 11-2024: either as supplementary documents stamped "not valid for claim of input tax", or converted into invoices by stamping "Invoice", until they run out.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/eopt-invoice-requirements-odoo

### What is an ATC code?

An Alphanumeric Tax Code identifies the type of income payment and its withholding rate, such as WC158 for a top withholding agent's purchase of goods from a corporation. It appears on the 2307, the QAP and the returns.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/expanded-withholding-tax-atc-codes-odoo

### Do I file 0619-E for the third month of the quarter?

No. The 0619-E covers the first two months; the third month is covered by the quarterly 1601-EQ, due the last day of the month after the quarter.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/expanded-withholding-tax-atc-codes-odoo

### Am I a top withholding agent if my sales pass P12 million?

Not automatically. Under RR 31-2020 the duty starts only once the BIR publishes your name on the list of top withholding agents.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/expanded-withholding-tax-atc-codes-odoo

### Where do I enter the ATC in Odoo?

On each withholding tax, under Accounting > Configuration > Taxes, in the Philippines ATC field on the Philippines tab.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/expanded-withholding-tax-atc-codes-odoo

### How long does an Odoo implementation take?

It depends on the scope: the number of apps, companies, integrations and how clean your data is. TechNext agrees the timeline in the written scope at the end of discovery, and keeps the first phase focused so it goes live sooner.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/how-an-odoo-implementation-works

### Can we start with just one Odoo app?

Yes. Odoo is modular, and Odoo's One App Free plan covers one app for unlimited users. Most TechNext projects start with Accounting, Sales and Inventory together, because that is where money and stock move.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/how-an-odoo-implementation-works

### What does TechNext need from us to start?

A short description of how your process runs today, a decision-maker for scope questions, and later the people who run sales, stock and finance for discovery and training.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/how-an-odoo-implementation-works

### Is InvoiceNow mandatory for GST-registered businesses?

Yes. IRAS requires all GST-registered businesses to submit invoice data using InvoiceNow-Ready Solutions, rolled out in phases between 1 November 2025 and 1 April 2031.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/invoicenow-singapore-gst-timeline

### When must an existing GST-registered business comply?

It depends on total annual supplies in 2025: S$200,000 or less from 1 April 2028, S$1 million or less from 1 April 2029, S$4 million or less from 1 April 2030, and above S$4 million from 1 April 2031.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/invoicenow-singapore-gst-timeline

### Which businesses are exempt from the GST InvoiceNow Requirement?

Overseas entities, including overseas vendors under the OVR pay-only and full regimes, and businesses liable to register for GST wholly because of the reverse charge regime.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/invoicenow-singapore-gst-timeline

### Can TechNext help us prepare Odoo for InvoiceNow?

Yes, on the Odoo side. TechNext helps you work out your implementation date and sets up your invoices in Odoo. We are not an Access Point Provider: we work with the IMDA-accredited Access Point Provider you choose, which carries your invoice data over the InvoiceNow network.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/invoicenow-singapore-gst-timeline

### Does Odoo 20 support InvoiceNow in Singapore?

The Odoo 20 release notes say Singapore GST taxes were refined to prepare for future GST InvoiceNow document compliance. They describe groundwork, so confirm the transmission path for your database with your Odoo partner before your InvoiceNow date.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-singapore-philippines-vietnam

### Can Odoo generate BIR Form 2307?

Yes. Odoo 20 adds report variants that produce BIR 2306 and BIR 2307 withholding tax certificates as PDFs in the BIR layout, generated from vendor bills and optionally sent to the vendor when a bill is paid.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-singapore-philippines-vietnam

### Does Odoo 20 follow Circular 99 in Vietnam?

Yes. The Vietnamese chart of accounts and balance sheet follow Circular 99/2025/TT-BTC, and the release notes say the S03a-DN general journal and S03b-DN general ledger reports, with counterpart accounts, comply with it.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-singapore-philippines-vietnam

### Does Odoo 20 include Philippine payroll?

Odoo 20 adds a basic Philippine payroll package with basic pay, benefits, taxes and overtime, plus BIR Forms 1601-C, 2316 and 1604-C and automatic SSS and Pag-IBIG loan deductions.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-singapore-philippines-vietnam

### How do I upgrade from Odoo 19 to Odoo 20?

Request an upgraded test database first: through the database manager on Odoo Online, through a staging branch on Odoo.sh, or with Odoo's upgrade script on-premise. Upgrade any custom modules, test thoroughly, then plan the production upgrade.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-upgrade-checklist

### Can I undo an Odoo 20 upgrade?

No. Odoo's documentation says that once the production upgrade is complete, you cannot revert to the previous version. That is why all testing happens on a copy first.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-upgrade-checklist

### Will my custom modules work in Odoo 20?

Not automatically. Custom modules must be ported to Odoo 20 before the database can be upgraded. Odoo's upgrade service covers standard apps and Studio customisations, but not custom code unless it is under a maintenance contract.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-upgrade-checklist

### Will the test database send emails to my customers?

No. In the upgraded test database, Odoo disables outgoing mail servers and scheduled actions, puts payment providers and delivery carriers in test mode, and turns off bank synchronisation.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-upgrade-checklist

### Can TechNext run our Odoo 20 upgrade?

Yes. TechNext upgrades a copy of your database first, tests your custom modules and a month-end close, then schedules the live upgrade and supports you afterwards through TechNext Care.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-upgrade-checklist

### What is in the Odoo 20 release notes?

The headline items are AI agents that automated actions can call, an MCP connector for outside AI tools, offline mode, bill payments and an Accounting Assistant. Field Service moves into Planning, payroll work entries are removed and account groups become parent accounts. Odoo publishes the full notes at odoo.com/odoo-20-release-notes.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-whats-new

### How do I upgrade to Odoo 20?

Odoo Online databases use Odoo's own upgrade service. Odoo.sh and on-premise databases, especially with custom modules, need a planned upgrade: check removed or moved features, test custom modules and Studio changes, budget AI credits, and do a dry run on a copy of the database before the live upgrade.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-whats-new

Odoo unveiled Odoo 20 at Odoo Experience 2026 at Brussels Expo, and published the release notes in September 2026.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-whats-new

### Do Odoo 20's AI features cost extra?

Yes. Odoo's release notes say every AI feature now uses paid IAP credits, which are billed on top of the Odoo subscription.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-whats-new

### Is the Field Service app gone in Odoo 20?

The standalone Field Service app is discontinued. Its features, including the live map, routing, travel fees and worksheets, now sit in the Planning app.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-whats-new

Yes. TechNext upgrades a copy of your database first, tests custom modules and a month-end close, and only then schedules the live upgrade.

Partly. Odoo kept One App Free and left Standard prices unchanged, raised the Custom plan by 20%, and added a Light User access type. It was the first change since 2022.

### Can we install custom modules on Odoo Online?

No. Odoo Online supports configuration and, on the Custom plan, Odoo Studio. Custom Python modules need Odoo.sh or an on-premise installation.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-online-vs-odoo-sh-vs-on-premise

### Which Odoo hosting option is cheapest?

Usually Odoo Online, because hosting is included in the subscription. Odoo.sh adds hosting fees on top of the Custom plan, and on-premise adds your own infrastructure and operations costs.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-online-vs-odoo-sh-vs-on-premise

### Can we move from Odoo Online to Odoo.sh later?

Yes. A database can move from Odoo Online to Odoo.sh or on-premise when you need custom code. TechNext plans and tests the move on a copy before switching.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-online-vs-odoo-sh-vs-on-premise

### Which hosting does TechNext recommend?

Odoo Online for most first phases, Odoo.sh when a requirement needs custom code, and on-premise only when IT policy or data rules require it.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-online-vs-odoo-sh-vs-on-premise

### Is Odoo or QuickBooks better for a Philippine small business?

It depends on what you run. A small service firm with an outside bookkeeper may be well served by QuickBooks Online. A business with stock, branches, a POS or payroll usually gets more from Odoo, where these run as apps beside Accounting.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-vs-quickbooks-philippines

### Does QuickBooks Online produce BIR Form 2307 or the SLSP?

Intuit's Philippine pages we checked do not mention these forms. Ask Intuit, or a local add-on provider, how you would produce the 2307, SLSP, SAWT and QAP in the format you file.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-vs-quickbooks-philippines

### Does the BIR endorse Odoo or QuickBooks?

The BIR's guidance we read does not name either brand. Under RMC 5-2021 and RMO 9-2021, each taxpayer registers its own computerised system, including third-party software, with the RDO or Large Taxpayers office where its head office is registered, which issues an Acknowledgement Certificate. Your accountant or RDO confirms what your registration needs.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-vs-quickbooks-philippines

### How many users can I have?

QuickBooks Online plans include 1, 3, 5 or 25 users, depending on the plan. Odoo subscriptions are priced per user, and Odoo's pricing page sets no fixed user limit on the Standard or Custom plans.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-vs-quickbooks-philippines

### Can I move from QuickBooks to Odoo later?

Yes. Plan the cut-over at a period end with your accountant. A new system needs its own CAS or CBA registration with the BIR before you use it, so check the steps with your RDO.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-vs-quickbooks-philippines

### Does Odoo 20 have Philippine payroll?

Yes. The Odoo 20 release notes list a basic Philippine payroll package with 1601-C items, the 2316, 1604-C worksheets, alphalist DAT exports and SSS and Pag-IBIG loan deductions.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/philippine-payroll-bir-forms-odoo-20

### When must employees get their BIR 2316?

By 31 January of the following year, or on the day of the last wage payment if they leave earlier (Tax Code Section 83).

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/philippine-payroll-bir-forms-odoo-20

### Is the 13th-month pay taxable?

Only the part above P90,000 a year, counted together with other bonuses and benefits under Section 32(B)(7)(e) of the Tax Code.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/philippine-payroll-bir-forms-odoo-20

### Can I use Odoo payroll on an older version?

Odoo's own Philippine payroll package is listed in the Odoo 20 release notes. Earlier versions typically relied on community or third-party apps. If you are on an older version, plan an upgrade; see our Odoo 20 upgrade checklist .

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/philippine-payroll-bir-forms-odoo-20

### Where do I register books of accounts now?

Online, in the BIR's ORUS at orus.bir.gov.ph. ORUS generates a QR stamp once registration succeeds. For loose-leaf and computerized books, the RDO stamps manually only with an ORUS downtime advisory or a screenshot of the error.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/register-books-of-accounts-orus-bir

### When are loose-leaf books due?

Bind them permanently and register them in ORUS within 15 days after the end of each taxable year, or within 15 days of closing the business if earlier. For calendar-year taxpayers, that is 15 January, so 15 January 2027 for taxable year 2026.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/register-books-of-accounts-orus-bir

### Do I register manual books every year?

No. Manual books are registered before use and again before their pages run out. If you choose to start a new set each year, register it before you use it.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/register-books-of-accounts-orus-bir

### Where does the QR stamp go for computerized books?

RMC 4-2026 says it is printed and kept for record purposes. RMC 3-2023 attached it to a transmittal letter for a USB drive of the books, and the 2023 ORUS guide mentioned submitting DVDs to the RDO, so ask your RDO whether it still wants those.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/register-books-of-accounts-orus-bir

### Can I start a new business on loose-leaf books?

Yes. RMC 65-2025 says a new business can choose manual, loose-leaf or computerized books. Loose-leaf books need a Permit to Use first, issued only after you have a TIN.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/register-books-of-accounts-orus-bir

### Is Odoo registered with the BIR?

The BIR registers each taxpayer's use of a system, not a software brand. Your business registers Odoo as its CAS or CBA at your RDO and receives an Acknowledgement Certificate.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/register-odoo-cas-cba-bir

### Do I still need a Permit to Use?

No. RMC 5-2021 replaced the Permit to Use with registration and an Acknowledgement Certificate. Existing PTUs stay valid unless revoked or the system has a major enhancement.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/register-odoo-cas-cba-bir

### Does my Acknowledgement Certificate let me issue e-invoices?

No. Under RMC 98-2026, the AC authorises the system but not e-invoicing. Covered taxpayers also need a Permit to Issue and EIS Certification.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/register-odoo-cas-cba-bir

### Do I need to re-register after upgrading Odoo?

Yes, if the upgrade changes the financial side. Under the BIR's CAS registration rules, a version change that affects the financial side of a registered CAS or CBA counts as a major enhancement, which needs an updated registration before you use it. Minor changes need only a written notice.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/register-odoo-cas-cba-bir

### What is CAS in BIR?

A Computerized Accounting System (CAS) processes the full accounting cycle, from the transaction and the system-generated invoice to the financial reports. If invoices are issued by hand, the BIR treats the system as Computerized Books of Accounts (CBA) instead (RMO 9-2021, RMC 98-2026).

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/register-odoo-cas-cba-bir

### What is the BIR CAS Acknowledgement Certificate?

It is the certificate your RDO issues within three working days of a complete CAS or CBA application, in place of the old Permit to Use (RMC 5-2021). It carries an AC control number (ACCN) that your system-generated invoices show, and the RDO evaluates the system afterwards.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/register-odoo-cas-cba-bir

### Do I need CAS if I also issue e-invoices through EIS?

They are separate. Under RMC 98-2026 the Acknowledgement Certificate for a CAS authorises the use of the system, while e-invoices need a Permit to Issue, and an e-invoice must come from a duly registered, approved or accredited system. The circular does not say every e-invoicing taxpayer needs a CAS, so ask your accountant or RDO which registrations your set-up needs.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/register-odoo-cas-cba-bir

### When should a small business move from spreadsheets to an ERP?

When the spreadsheets create more work than they save: data typed twice, stock you can't trust, slow month-ends, or reports that depend on one person. The trigger is friction, not company size.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/signs-you-have-outgrown-spreadsheets

### Do we have to replace everything at once?

No. With a modular ERP such as Odoo you can start with the apps where money and stock move, usually Accounting, Sales and Inventory, and add others later on the same database.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/signs-you-have-outgrown-spreadsheets

### Can our existing spreadsheet data be imported?

Yes. Customers, vendors, products and opening balances can be imported. TechNext cleans and loads them on a staging database and reconciles balances before go-live.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/signs-you-have-outgrown-spreadsheets

### What is the difference between Odoo configuration and customisation?

Configuration uses the settings and options Odoo already has, such as taxes, workflows and approval rules. Customisation changes the software itself, either with Odoo Studio (no code) or with custom Python modules.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/standard-first-odoo-customisation

### Do customisations make Odoo upgrades harder?

Yes. Odoo releases a major version every year, and custom modules must be ported and retested for each one. Studio changes need checking too. The fewer customisations, the easier each upgrade.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/standard-first-odoo-customisation

### Does TechNext build custom Odoo modules?

Yes, when a requirement justifies it. TechNext builds custom modules on staging, keeps them in version control and includes them in upgrade testing, after checking that configuration or Studio can't do the job.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/standard-first-odoo-customisation

### What does ERP stand for?

Enterprise resource planning: software that runs a company's core processes, such as sales, inventory, purchasing and accounting, on one shared database.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/what-is-erp

### Is ERP only for large companies?

No. Modular ERPs such as Odoo let a small company start with a few apps and add more as it grows. The trigger is friction between tools, not headcount.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/what-is-erp

### What is the difference between ERP and CRM?

A CRM manages leads and customer relationships. An ERP covers the whole operation, and usually includes a CRM, so a won deal becomes an order, a delivery and an invoice in the same system.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/what-is-erp

### Is Odoo BIR-accredited?

No, and no accounting software is. Odoo 20's Philippine localisation produces the data for the recurring BIR reports: invoices set up for BIR and CAS requirements, a Book of Accounts for CAS and CBA, 2306 and 2307 certificates, SLSP, SAWT, QAP and 2550Q. It is not a BIR registration in itself: you file your CAS and e-invoicing applications with the BIR yourself, and TechNext helps you prepare the Odoo outputs for them. The BIR does not accredit accounting software brands, and it has not accredited or endorsed any e-invoicing service provider (BIR advisory, 14 September 2026), so treat any "BIR-accredited" claim with care: the permit is issued to your business for the system you register. See BIR rules for your accounting system .

Source: https://technext.asia/odoo/philippines

Source: https://technext.asia/odoo/vietnam

### Does Odoo follow Circular 99 in Vietnam?

Yes. In Odoo 20, the Vietnamese chart of accounts and balance sheet follow Circular 99/2025/TT-BTC, and the S03a-DN general journal and S03b-DN general ledger now show counterpart accounts. Circular 99 replaces Circular 200 for financial years starting on or after 1 January 2026.

Source: https://technext.asia/odoo/vietnam

### Can Odoo issue e-invoices in Vietnam?

Yes. Odoo sends invoices to SInvoice, Viettel's e-invoice platform, including replacement and adjustment invoices. In Odoo 20, Point of Sale can also issue SInvoice e-invoices for POS orders.

Source: https://technext.asia/odoo/vietnam

### Which decree governs e-invoices in Vietnam now?

Decree 254/2026/ND-CP, in force since 1 July 2026 with Circular 91/2026/TT-BTC. It replaces Decree 123/2020/ND-CP as amended by Decree 70/2025/ND-CP. Odoo's documentation does not mention the new decree yet, so we check your invoice setup against it during discovery.

Source: https://technext.asia/odoo/vietnam

### Is VAT in Vietnam still 8%?

For many goods and services, yes, until 31 December 2026. Resolution 204/2025/QH15 cut the 10% rate to 8% from 1 July 2025, with some sectors left out, such as telecoms, banking, insurance and real estate. We set the rate per product with your accountant.

Source: https://technext.asia/odoo/vietnam

### Can Odoo export the 01/GTGT VAT declaration?

Yes. Odoo 20 adds the Tax Declaration Form 01/GTGT and its Appendix 142, and exports both as XML for import into HTKK.

Source: https://technext.asia/odoo/vietnam

### Can one Odoo database run our Vietnamese and Singapore companies?

Yes. Odoo runs a company per country in one database, each with its own localisation, currencies and reports, with intercompany transactions between them.

Source: https://technext.asia/odoo/vietnam

### Do all entities have to go live at once?

No. We implement a pilot entity first, then roll out company by company. Each entity goes live when ready.

Source: https://technext.asia/solutions/enterprise

### How does consolidation work?

Group P&L, balance sheet and cash come from the same database, with eliminations done in Odoo, so there is no spreadsheet consolidation.

Source: https://technext.asia/solutions/enterprise

### Can each country keep its own tax rules?

Yes. Every entity uses its own country localisation, and group reports roll up in one currency.

Source: https://technext.asia/solutions/enterprise

People see their own company's data and only the group views you grant, with approval chains and audit trails.

### Can Odoo handle BIR reporting?

Yes, TechNext sets up Odoo's Philippine localisation for your company. Odoo produces the 2307, SLSP, SAWT, QAP and 2550Q from the invoices and bills you post, and can serve as your computerised books. Odoo has no built-in EIS connection, and TechNext has not built one; if you are covered, we assess options and quote separately.

Source: https://technext.asia/solutions/odoo-erp

### Is Odoo BIR-accredited?

No accounting software is BIR-accredited in that sense. The BIR registers your books and issues your Permit to Issue for the system you use. We set Odoo up for BIR requirements; your business registers it as its books. See BIR rules for your accounting system .

Source: https://technext.asia/solutions/odoo-erp

### Can we keep some of our existing systems?

Yes. That is the idea of Odoo as a plug-in in your system : if a system works, we connect Odoo to it instead of replacing it.

Customers, vendors and products come across in full. For transactions we usually bring opening balances and open items, and keep the old system for history.
